Render a Whole Folder of Reports Once per Parameter Set

Source: R/render_parameterized_study.R
render_parameterized_study.Rd

[render_parameterized_pair()] for a folder: every `.qmd`/`.Rmd` file in `source_dir` is rendered once per entry of `param_list`, and the outputs of entry `i` go to `target_dirs[i]`. This replaces keeping a mirrored copy of the folder (for example `compute_index/` and `compute_index_impute/`) that differs only in a few parameters. The templates themselves are never copied or changed.

Usage

render_parameterized_study(
  source_dir,
  target_dirs,
  param_list,
  pattern = "\\.(qmd|Rmd)$",
  recursive = FALSE,
  formats = "html",
  on_error = c("continue", "stop"),
  dry_run = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

source_dir

Folder with the templates.

target_dirs

Output folders, one per parameter set (created if missing). Unnamed or named.

param_list

A list of named parameter lists, the same length as `target_dirs`.

pattern

Regular expression for the files to render (default `"\.(qmd|Rmd)$"`, ignoring case).

recursive

Also look in sub-folders (default `FALSE`).

formats

Output formats (default `"html"`).

on_error

`"continue"` (default; failures are reported in the result) or `"stop"`.

dry_run

Plan only; nothing is rendered.

...

Further arguments for [render_variants()] (`self_contained`, `check_params`, `renderer`, `quiet`).

Value

A tibble, one row per document, parameter set and format, with the columns of [render_variants()] plus `document` and `target_dir`.

Details

Files whose name starts with `_` or `.` are skipped (Quarto includes and children). A document that does not declare a parameter in its YAML header fails (see [render_variants()]); with `on_error = "continue"` the others are still rendered.

See also

[render_parameterized_pair()], [render_variants()]

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
render_parameterized_study(
  "analysis/compute_index",
  target_dirs = c("reports/compute_index", "reports/compute_index_impute"),
  param_list  = list(list(use_imputed = FALSE), list(use_imputed = TRUE))
)
} # }
